decided: The brief reads an archive record's sync in each shape archive records have been written in, as the record states it, and gives a record that states it in none of them a line saying it does not say whether the requirements were synced, instead of refusing the brief.
alternatives: refuse such records and name the limit in the spec, leaving their changes and their program with no brief for good
read only the current shape and give every older record the line saying it does not say
why: An archived record is never edited, so a refusal could never be repaired, and a finished program would have no brief at all; each older shape states the sync as plainly as the current one, so reading it infers nothing. The user chose this at the system walk.
detail: readArchive: sync_specs.ran, else specs_synced, else sync.synced, else a sync_specs listing at least one capability in capabilities_updated (ran), else the 'unstated' state. Test: 'an archive record of an earlier shape is read as it states the sync'.
